name: The Eye of the Storm: A Moonstray Story
source:
You wake up on the shores of Moonstray with no memories of who you were. Rescued by Rowan, you are given a fresh start in a quiet fishing village with the locals. But beneath Rowan’s stoic attitude lies a deep, unspoken mystery. As a strange storm gathers on the horizon, you must decide if you can break down his walls before the past pulls him under.

[From [url=https://marrowdonvn.itch.io/the-eye-of-the-storm-a-moonstray-story]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你在月荒海岸醒来，不记得自己是谁。被罗文救出后，你将在一个安静的渔村与当地人一起重新开始。但罗文坚忍的态度背后隐藏着一个深刻的、不言而喻的谜团。当一场奇怪的风暴在地平线上聚集时，你必须决定是否能在过去把他拖垮之前打破他的围墙。

[来自[url=https://marrowdonvn.itch.io/the-eye-of-the-storm-a-moonstray-story]itch.io[/url]]
